## Terrible monsters, timeless upheaval.

Kaiju are monstrous giants of destruction and age, like if the consequences of hubris hated you specifically. Like most wetware, the finger of blame is most often pointed at biodiversity projects of old being reclaimed by nature, and while comparatively tame organisms like dinosaurs are classified as kaiju for this reason, there's more to the story. The sheer variety and former proliferance of kaiju would suggest they are a hyperadaptive sort of creature with all the benefits of an extremophile, all the size of a city block, and a nasty habit of rearranging spire skylines.

### [Young Sparkhide Ryuukaiju](/foe:110-young-sparkhide-ryuukaiju)

The eager and starving hunter of the sands, the young sparkhide scours the desert that surrounds its buried feeding ground, awaiting the chance that it might claim a greater meal in the form of some hapless traveler. Like a broken circuit, the opportunistic kaiju of sand, storm, and shell will await the path of least resistance before springing from the sand with all the speed of a lightning bolt. While oft spotted alone, where one young sparkhide has survived, yet more grow older deep beneath the dunes.

*Young Sparkhide Ryuukaiju · *Large Kaiju* · **Armor Class** 18 (natural) · **Hit Points** 171 (18d10 + 72; bloodied 86) · **Speed** 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., swim 20 ft. · STR — DEX — CON — INT — WIS — CHA · 20 (+5) — 10 (+0) — 18 (+4) — 14 (+2) — 16 (+3) — 12 (+1) · **Saving Throws** Dex +4, Con +8, Wis +7, Cha +5 · **Skills** Perception +11, Stealth +4, Survival +7 · **Damage Immunities** lightning · **Senses** blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 21 · **Challenge** 11 (7,200 XP) · **Proficiency Bonus** +4 · ***Desert Dweller.*** The kaiju ignores difficult terrain or obscurement caused by sand or gravel. Additionally, it ignores the effects of extreme heat. · ***Dune Splitter.*** The kaiju can remain submerged in sand and gravel for up to 8 hours. It has advantage on Stealth checks to hide in this way. Additionally, the kaiju can tunnel through earth and solid rock, leaving behind a 10-foot-diamater tunnel, which collapses at the start of the kaiju's next turn if it is loose material, such as sand or gravel. · Actions · ***Multiattack.*** The kaiju attacks one with its bite and twice with its claws. It can replace its claw attacks with a tail stinger attack, attacking a different target than its bite attack. · ***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d8) lightning damage. If the target is a Small or smaller creature, it makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the target is swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover from attacks from outside the kaiju, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage and 14 (4d6) lightning damage at the start of each of the kaiju's turns. If a swallowed creature deals 30 or more damage to the kaiju in a single turn, or if the kaiju dies, the kaiju vomits up all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the kaiju. · ***Claws.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. · ***Tail Stinger.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. *Hit:* 16 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target makes a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) poison damage and 21 (6d6) lightning damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. · ***Sparkhide Proof (Recharge 5-6).*** The kaiju exhales a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of electricity. Each creature in that area makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) lightning damage and losing its reaction until the end of its next turn on a failed save or half damage on a success. · Bonus Actions · ***Discharge.*** The kaiju becomes wreathed in static electricity, sand clinging to it like a cloak. For the kaiju's next four attacks or uses of sparkhide proof, hit or miss, each lightning damage die it rolls is rolled twice, taking the higher result. After it has made all of its discharging attacks, all lightning damage the kaiju deals is treated as rolling its minimum value until it spends an entire turn submerged. · ***Rising Sands.*** After spending an entire turn submerged, the kaiju can dash, and in doing so, treat its movement speed as if it were a fly speed until the end of its turn. It does not take falling damage if it ends this movement less than 100 feet off the ground.*
